images.filename: Calm water and frozen towing path - geograph.org.uk - 1634422.jpg
images.caption: Calm water and frozen towing path, near to Llangollen, Denbighshire/Sir Ddinbych, Great Britain. The towing path is normally soft and muddy along this stretch in the winter but today it's frozen hard. The skeletol winter trees are beautifully reflected in the blue but very cold water. The canal is an aqueduct supplying Crewe's drinking water and has a fairly rapid flow which helps to stop its freezing.
images.alt: Calm water and frozen towing path, near to Llangollen, Denbighshire/Sir Ddinbych, Great Britain. The towing path is normally soft and muddy along this stretch in the winter but today it's frozen hard. The skeletol winter trees are beautifully reflected in the blue but very cold water. The canal is an aqueduct supplying Crewe's drinking water and has a fairly rapid flow which helps to stop its freezing.
